product.title: Gesto 5V USB Led Strip Light – Music Sync RGB Multicolor Background Lighting for TV PC Laptop Bias Lighting Gaming Room | TV Backlight Bluetooth App. and Remote Controlled (5 Meter for 49-85" TV’s)
product.customers_say: Customers find the LED strip light gives premium looks and ambience for TV rooms, with good brightness and color options. However, the product receives mixed feedback about its quality, value for money, and reliability - while some say it turns out better than expected and is worth the price, others report receiving faulty products and issues with blue LEDs not working. Moreover, the Bluetooth connectivity is problematic, with multiple customers reporting issues with the remote control and app functionality. Additionally, the adhesive quality is poor, with customers noting it won't stick to TVs.

feedback_topics.name: Appearance
feedback_topics.text: Customers appreciate the appearance of the LED strip light, saying it gives a premium look and ambience to the TV room, with one customer noting it creates a cozy atmosphere.

feedback_topics.name: Quality
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed opinions about the string light's quality, with some finding it better than expected while others report receiving faulty products.

feedback_topics.name: Value for money
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed opinions about the string light's value for money, with some finding it worth the price and considering it the best RGB light at that price point, while others say it's a waste of time.

feedback_topics.name: Reliability
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed experiences with the string light's reliability, with some reporting it works perfectly fine while others mention issues with the app not working and only the blue LED functioning properly.

feedback_topics.name: Brightness
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed opinions about the brightness of the string light, with some finding it good while others report it being very low.

feedback_topics.name: Color options
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed opinions about the LED strip's color options, with some appreciating the bright colors and availability of all colors, while others report missing colors like pink and yellow.

feedback_topics.name: Bluetooth connectivity
feedback_topics.text: Customers report issues with the Bluetooth connectivity of the string light, including problems with the remote control and app functionality.

feedback_topics.name: Adhesive
feedback_topics.text: Customers report issues with the string light's adhesive, noting that it is really bad and won't stick to their TVs.
